method.name: despawn
method.description: Frees the object right away, like [code]destroy[/code] in GD++ code. It's thread-safe: on other threads than the main one, it leaves nodes in the scene tree to the main thread, which frees them at the end of the frame.

method.name: evict_scene
method.description: Drops the class's kept scene, e.g. when a level is unloaded, so that Godot can free it once nothing else uses it. The next creation or cache loads it again. Objects created from it stay as they are. It's thread-safe.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Creates an instance of the class's scene, like [code]create[/code] in GD++ code, and returns its root. The scene is loaded once, by the first call. Returns [code]null[/code] if the scene fails to load, or if its root isn't an object of this class, so always check the result. [code]new()[/code] creates the node alone, without the scene.
